snippet.title: Forza Horizon 5 - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/forza-horizon-5/

Your ultimate Horizon adventure awaits! Explore the vibrant and ever-evolving open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in over 800 of the world’s greatest cars. 
 
Play with friends across every platform with cross play functionality. 
 
Pre-order Forza Horizon 5 Premium Edition for Early Access on April 25.

#ps5 #ps5games #forzahorizon5
